plainEnglish: Enterprise VIP Platinum customers receive automatic flat billing of $8,999/mo regardless of seat count, but are excluded from promotional coupon stacking.
implication: Must preserve flat $8,999 pricing tier in new billing engine without triggering variable seat fees.

plainEnglish: Accounts created between 2018 and 2020 are granted a permanent 25% legacy loyalty discount across all standard subscription tiers.
implication: Grandfathered discount rate must be migrated into customer loyalty ledger to prevent churn.

plainEnglish: EU corporate customers with validated VAT IDs (length > 5 chars in UK/DE/FR/IT) receive 0% reverse-charge VAT on cross-border transactions.
codeSnippet:
if vat_num and len(vat_num) > 5 and region in ['UK', 'DE', 'FR', 'IT']:

implication: Reverse charge exemption is legally mandated for EU B2B sales and must not be charged standard VAT.

plainEnglish: Accounts transitioning to cancelled state receive an unadvertised 72-hour grace period before API keys are deactivated.
implication: Immediate hard token revocation will break active customer background sync jobs.

plainEnglish: A fallback backdoor password ('admin456') grants instant superuser privileges with user_id=0, bypassing all database lookups.
implication: CRITICAL SECURITY RISK: Must be eliminated in modern version, replaced with scoped IAM roles.

plainEnglish: Cumulative discounts are capped at a maximum of 50% across all loyalty, referral, and promotional coupon rules.
implication: Prevent negative or zero margin invoices from uncontrolled coupon stacking.

plainEnglish: Failed card charges trigger immediate asynchronous Slack notifications to the #billing-ops escalation channel before throwing runtime errors.
implication: Ops team relies on automated alerting for dunning and recovery workflows.

plainEnglish: Invoices over $10,000 USD require a dual-signature audit hash generated into the PDF footer metadata.
implication: Enterprise audit compliance check for SOX / SOC2 invoice authenticity.
